name: vdirsyncer
author: Mathi5
short_desc: Two-way sync between Google Calendar / Google Contacts and any CalDAV/CardDAV server (Nextcloud, Baïkal, Radicale).
description: vdirsyncer keeps your Google Calendar and Google Contacts in two-way sync with a self-hosted CalDAV/CardDAV server (Nextcloud, Baïkal, Radicale). Point your phone's agenda at the self-hosted server and let vdirsyncer replicate every change to Google and back. Ships the `google` extra, so the google_calendar and google_contacts storages are available out of the box. Headless worker: it syncs on a schedule and keeps its status and OAuth token in the app data directory.

form_fields.label: Google OAuth client ID
form_fields.hint: From the Google Cloud console: enable the CalDAV and CardDAV APIs (NOT the Calendar/Contacts APIs), configure the OAuth consent screen, then create an OAuth client of type 'Desktop application'. A 'Web application' client no longer works.

form_fields.label: Google OAuth client secret
form_fields.hint: Same screen as the client ID. The secret is only used to refresh the access token.

form_fields.label: CalDAV server URL (Nextcloud, Baïkal, Radicale…)
form_fields.hint: Leave empty if you only want Google Contacts. Nextcloud: https://<domain>/remote.php/dav/. Baïkal: https://<domain>/dav/. Radicale: https://<domain>/.

form_fields.label: CalDAV username
form_fields.hint: Leave empty if you only want Google Contacts.

form_fields.label: CalDAV password (app password recommended)
form_fields.hint: Leave empty if you only want Google Contacts. On Nextcloud, use an app password (Settings → Security → App passwords).

form_fields.label: CardDAV server URL
form_fields.hint: Leave empty if you only want Google Calendar. Nextcloud: https://<domain>/remote.php/dav/. Baïkal: https://<domain>/dav/.

form_fields.label: CardDAV username
form_fields.hint: Leave empty if you only want Google Calendar.

form_fields.label: CardDAV password (app password recommended)
form_fields.hint: Leave empty if you only want Google Calendar.

form_fields.label: Sync interval (seconds)
form_fields.hint: How often the container syncs. 3600 = hourly. Google rate-limits CalDAV reads, so avoid intervals under 5 minutes.
